title: Pre Cruise Vancouver City Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover what makes Vancouver one of the world’s most cosmopolitan cities on this 5-hour guided pre-cruise city tour. Your personal chauffeur and expert guide provide engaging insights into Vancouver’s mix of cultures, modern city planning, and iconic landmarks. Enjoy a small-group experience, limited to 6 people, with round-trip hotel transport in a luxury vehicle. Highlights include all major city stops, flexible exploration, and included admission to the Vancouver Lookout.

The 6-Hour Pinnacle Luxury Tour★ offers VIP comfort with a large SUV, senior expert guide, premium amenities, and airport pick-up for a seamless experience. The 5-Hour Summit Experience provides a private SUV, professional guide, and a customizable itinerary, ensuring a comfortable and unforgettable Vancouver adventure.
